name: Becuz
summary: Explains why a small shop's weekly profit moved, in naira, with a receipt for every claim, and keeps missing cash apart from profit.
track: The Agent That Can Explain Why

agents.name: Planner
agents.role: Opens a signed investigation contract (Scout Intent), recalls causes the owner confirmed before (H-MEM), measures the profit tree in Zetaris, and orders the causes to test.

agents.name: Investigator
agents.role: Measures one cause with its SQL template through Zetaris and proposes a claim with its record IDs to the shared World Model. Re-tests a claim the Checker sends back.

agents.name: Checker
agents.role: Re-runs each claim's SQL itself, then supports, rejects or sends it back (up to 2 times). Asks NVIDIA Nemotron through Nightshift to rate the evidence, as a Markovian chain.

agents.name: Writer
agents.role: Builds the report from supported claims only: ranked profit causes, cash gaps, ruled-out causes, recalled memory and actions. The report schema re-checks that every figure adds up.

sponsor_technology.zetaris: The agent's only data path. Four S3 CSV sources are registered as Lightning databases; the becuz USL declares 12 tables, and two of them (daily_pnl and transfer_check) compute the profit tree and the transfer-to-bank match inside Zetaris. A data-quality rule flags transfers that never reached the bank. The agent reads as a non-admin user with SELECT on the USL only.
sponsor_technology.meterless_nightshift: Every model call goes through Nightshift, with the answering model and receipt ID recorded per call.
meterless_engines: Scout Intent: signed investigation contract that every query must fit
World Model: shared claims list with the full history of each verdict
H-MEM: owner-confirmed causes, recalled and tested first in later runs
Markovian: the Checker's model calls as a chain with a short carryover
sponsor_technology.nvidia: Nemotron models, through Nightshift, rate the evidence for each checked claim.

data_sources: Synthetic shop data generated by data/generator.py (data/scenarios/s01 to s05), loaded into Zetaris from S3

entry_points.docker: docker build -t becuz . && docker run --rm -p 8000:8000 becuz

sample_mode: SAMPLE_MODE=1 runs the full investigation offline on the bundled data
